name: trend
title: Trend
description: Numeric delta indicator. A small chip showing change vs a baseline: '+12.4%', '−3 units', '+$420'. Auto-derives tone from the sign (positive=accent, negative=danger, zero=neutral) unless the consumer flips polarity (some KPIs are 'lower is better' — e.g. churn, page load time). Used inside KPI cards, Stat blocks, table rows, and AI summaries.
